name: Original first gate: heal through ordinary spell selection and Cast

local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local types=require('openmw.types')
local t=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 if core.isWorldPaused() then return end
 t=t+dt;if t<.2 then return end;t=0
 assert(not types.Actor.isDead(self),'Player died in original gate entrance')
 local health=types.Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current
 local magicka=types.Actor.stats.dynamic.magicka(self).current
 if health<=100 and magicka>=25 then print('KvatchIlend cast ready') end
 print('KvatchIlend health='..tostring(health)..' position='..tostring(self.position))
 if health>100 then print('KvatchIlend healed for progression') end
end}}}}
